column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each annual return record for funds by year.
Foreign key referencing funds.TickerSym, indicating which fund the annual return data belongs to.
Calendar year (YYYY) for which the return performance is recorded.
Fund's return performance for the specific calendar year as decimal (-1 to positive). Contains  NULL when fund performance data is not available for that year (e.g., fund not yet launched).
Category or benchmark average return performance for the same calendar year for comparison. Contains  NULL when category performance data is not available for comparison.
